nvitk.gui.app
=============

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.app

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Napari application shell for the nvitk GUI.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.app._record_step
   nvitk.gui.app._layer_display_kwargs
   nvitk.gui.app._refresh_layer_list
   nvitk.gui.app.run_app


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _record_step(state: dict[str, Any], step: dict[str, Any]) -> None

   Append a timestamped *step* to the app's pipeline recording, if recording is enabled.


.. py:function:: _layer_display_kwargs(layer: Any, *, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]

   Preserve spatial metadata from a source layer when adding tool outputs.


.. py:function:: _refresh_layer_list(widget: Any, viewer: Any, registry: dict[str, Any]) -> None

   Rebuild the Layers tab's summary list widget from the viewer's layers and the app's input/
   output/mesh registry.


.. py:function:: run_app() -> None

   Build and launch the nvitk Napari GUI: creates the viewer, installs nvitk's I/O hooks, and
   assembles the Tools/Data/QC/Statmodels/Layers/Export/Pipeline dock tabs.
